verdict.rationale: SumUp is a payments platform. Plugging MCP servers into it so it can use their tools would require it to be an MCP client or agent host, which is a different product role. The evidence shows SumUp only in the server and tool-provider role: a managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that give other agents SumUp tools. None of that is client-side MCP consumption, so it does not make this axis applicable.
